text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Can you hear it, this thunderous cheer! The massive applause praising this year's Derby Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But I couldn't grasp it, huh.
I really wanted to cross the finish line first...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It's so frustrating...!
I'm so, so frustrated...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: My legs won't even move anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
Big siiis...!
That was amazing, so amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Man, look at her...
She's completely exhausted. ...And yet.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text: Why does this look so cool...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...I have... to stand up...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I have... to go...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Please... Lend me your shoulder.
I want to get even closer...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
“......If even a single pair of hands in this applause
is clapping for me...!”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(It was my dream. Wrapped in roaring cheers,
sprinting with all my might across the turf.
Taking 1st place in the Derby.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Yet I couldn't.
Even though I gave it everything I had,
I fell short in so many ways.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(...I barely have any strength left in my legs.
Even so...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I want to make a promise... to the people who support me.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOAAAH!
Congrats on 1st plaaace!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Big siiiiiis!!
Ines, you didn't give up! Good job!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. I can hear it.
That voice reaches my ears.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
“...So you see, I'm going to win next time.
I'll definitely win.”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'll keep giving it my all from now on, too...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...!
...Good work today, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's meet again at the Kikuka Sho.
I know you'll definitely make it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once we reached the waiting room,
she smiled and gently raised a hand, signaling that she was fine now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Was I able to wave properly
to everyone out there?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's... good... then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flump...!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...What a relief...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Ines Fujin collapsed
onto the floor of the waiting room.
